NONE: › to move people from a dangerous place to somewhere safe
（把人從危險的地方）撤離，撤出，疏散，轉移

example: The police evacuated the village shortly before the explosion.
在爆炸前不久，警察將這個村莊裡的人全都疏散了。
A thousand people were evacuated from their homes following the floods.
洪水爆發後，有1000人撤離了他們的家園。
When toxic fumes began to drift toward our homes, we were told to evacuate.
當毒霧開始朝我們住宅區方向飄移時，我們被通知撤離。

NONE: › someone who is evacuated from a dangerous place, especially during a war
（尤指戰爭中的）被撤離者，被疏散者

example: Thousands of evacuees crossed the border to safety.
數以千計的被疏散者越過邊界到達了安全地帶。

NONE: › formal to avoid or escape from someone or something
逃脫，躲開；迴避，逃避
› to intentionally not talk about something or not answer something
迴避議題／問題（等等）

example: The police have assured the public that the escaped prisoners will not evade recapture for long.
警方向大眾保證，逃犯很快就會再次落網。
She leaned forward to kiss him but he evaded her by pretending to sneeze.
她身子前傾想要吻他，可是他假裝打噴嚏躲開了。
An Olympic gold medal is the only thing that has evaded her in her remarkable career.
在其輝煌的運動生涯中，唯一沒有得到的榮譽就是奧運金牌。
[ + -ing verb ] He can't evade doing military service forever.
他不可能永遠逃避兵役。
Just give me an answer and stop evading the question!
直截了當地回答我，不要再迴避問題！

NONE: C1 to judge or calculate the quality, importance, amount, or value of something
評估，評價；估值

example: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.
如不能對使用的研究方法有更多了解，就無法對其結果作出評價。
[ + question word ] We shall need to evaluate how the new material stands up to wear and tear.
我們需要對新材料的耐磨損度作出鑒定。

NONE: › lasting for only a short time, then disappearing quickly and being forgotten
短暫的，轉瞬即逝的；迅速遺忘的
› belonging to one of the Protestant Churches or Christian groups that believe the teaching of the Bible and persuading other people to join them to be extremely important
基督教福音派的
› having very strong beliefs and often trying to persuade other people to have the same beliefs
（信仰上）狂熱的；熱衷傳播自己觀點的

example: the Evangelical movement
福音派宗教運動
Why is it that people who've given up smoking become so evangelical and intolerant of other smokers?
爲甚麽戒了煙的人會變得如此熱衷於規勸別人戒煙，而且不能容忍別人抽煙呢？

NONE: › a person who tries to persuade people to become Christians, often by travelling around and organizing religious meetings
（基督教）佈道者，旅行傳道者
› one of the writers of the four books in the Bible about Jesus Christ
（基督教）《福音書》四作者之一

example: See also
televangelist (televangelism)

I: › [ I ] to talk about how good you think something is

T: › [ T ] to try to persuade people to become Christians

example: I wish she would stop evangelizing about the virtues of free market economics.
我希望她不要再鼓吹自由市場經濟的好處了。

I or T: › [ I or T ] to cause a liquid to change to a gas, especially by heating

example: The high concentration of sugars forms a syrup when the sap evaporates.
當樹汁中的水分蒸發時，糖分就濃縮成糖漿。
Plants keep cool during the summer by evaporating water from their leaves.
夏天植物透過葉子蒸發水分保持清涼。
Halfway through the movie reality evaporates and we enter a world of pure fantasy.
電影看到一半，我們就離開現實世界，完全進入了幻境中。

NONE: › milk that has been made thicker by removing some of the water from it, used to make sweet dishes
煉乳；淡煉乳
› a small, flat dish used in scientific work to heat and evaporate substances
蒸發皿
› the process by which water moves from the earth to the air through evaporation and transpiration (= water lost from plants)
（土壤水分）蒸散作用
› the act of avoiding something or someone
逃脫；躲開；迴避；逃避

example: Her speech was full of excuses and evasions and never properly addressed the issue.
她的談話從頭到尾都是些藉口托詞，根本就沒有切實談過這個問題。
tax evasion (= illegally not paying tax)
逃稅

NONE: › answering questions in a way that is not direct or clear, especially because you do not want to give an honest answer
迴避的；推託的；閃爍其辭的
› done to avoid something bad happening
規避的

example: The Minister was her usual evasive self, skilfully dodging reporters' questions about her possible resignation.
部長還是保持顧左右而言他的一貫風格，當記者問及她是否可能辭職時，她駕輕就熟地避而不答。
By the time the pilot realized how close the plane was to the building, it was too late to take evasive action.
當飛行員意識到飛機與大樓非常接近時，已經來不及採取任何閃避措施了。
Drivers had to make sudden evasive manoeuvres.
駕駛員必須做出突然的閃避動作。
